name: Brown Sugar Bacon Lettuce Wraps with Lime Aioli & Pickled Cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes
6 tomatoes
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place vinegar, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the pickling liquid.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup white wine vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 2-inch long pieces. Add to the bowl with the pickling liquid, stir to combine, and set aside.
Halve bacon crosswise and place on a plate. Sprinkle with sugar on both sides.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, working in batches, add bacon and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and crispy, 6-8 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Zest and juice limes into the bowl with the cilantro. Add mayo and spices, then whisk to combine the lime aioli. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Slice tomatoes crosswise into thin rounds.
Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; top with tomatoes and bacon. Drizzle with lime aioli and serve with pickled cucumbers on the side. Enjoy!
